item.description: Robert Owen Anderson, aged 88, passed away from natural causes on Feb. 3, 2026, in Meridian. item.title: Linda Ann Nordby Carpenter
item.description: Linda Ann Nordby Carpenter was born on Dec. 4, 1946, in Lewiston, Idaho. Growing up in Lewiston, Linda developed the values that guided her life – faith, family, and community. Linda attended the University of Idaho, where she graduated in 1969 with a bachelor’s degree in education, laying the foundation for a lifelong career devoted to teaching and nurturing young minds. item.title: Wastewater plant protects health, environment
item.description: The Weiser Wastewater Treatment Plant plays a critical role in protecting our community’s health and environment. The facility is built to handle a hydraulic average capacity of 2.4 million gallons of wastewater per day, ensuring that the water processed meets or exceeds strict EPA and Idaho DEQ standards before it is released back into the environment. item.title: Idaho State Legislature Feb. 9-13
item.description: District 9 Representatives are: John Shirts (208) 550-3190, Judy Boyle (208) 355-3225, and Senator Brandon Shippy (208) 332-1325. *** The bill count in the 2026 Idaho Legislature mounted to 182 in the House and 76 in the Senate by the end of the day, Friday, Feb. 13. Feb. 9 HO494 - HEALTH AND WELFARE – Amends, repeals, and adds to existing law to establish provisions regarding background checks conducted by the Department of Health and Welfare. House passed 36-33-1. Shirts, Boyle Nay. HO500 - MO
